statement: The equation for the best x-hat is A^T A x-hat = A^T b, the "famous form" of A^T(b - A x-hat) = 0 with coefficient matrix A^T A.
quotes: in its famous form $A ^ { \mathrm { T } } A { \widehat { \mathbf { x } } } = A ^ { \mathrm { T } } b$
